package.name: hhros2_description
package.description: Single source of truth for the Yidong humanoid (00_infrastructure): URDF/Xacro kinematics plus the ros2_control hardware tag that binds 23 logical joints to a selectable SystemInterface (real EXIPC client, MuJoCo sim, or mock). Shared by real and simulation deployments so Sim-to-Real swaps only the hardware plugin.
